title: Protean eGov Technologies (NSE: PROTEAN) — Institutional Investment Monograph
holding_rationale: PROTEAN is not held in the Zerodha portfolio ledger (0 shares). Given the post-FY27 PAN 2.0 transition cliff on ~50% of revenue, 10.0% ROE, ₹12 Cr FY26 free cash flow, and 36.6x–38.3x P/E valuation above our ₹650 base-case fair value, we assign REJECTED and hold 0 shares.

holding_alerts.trigger: Base-case reassessment only on sustained quarterly OPM >= 15.0% and DSO <= 65 days
holding_alerts.instruction: Remain uninvested; revisit only if core operating margins and cash conversion recover post-PAN 2.0 clarity.

holding_alerts.trigger: Deep-value dislocation below ₹550 (below 2.1x P/B and ~₹197/sh net cash support)
holding_alerts.instruction: Re-underwrite valuation only if price drops into deep-value territory with confirmed UIDAI/CRA margin expansion.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Next marginal INR capital unit under review (no existing PROTEAN position to liquidate)

destinations.rationale: With PROTEAN rejected on valuation (38.3x TTM P/E vs. 10.0% ROE) and FCF compression (₹12 Cr in FY26), retaining 100% of the marginal capital unit in cash preserves dry powder until an underwritten Stage 2 setup clears all fundamental and entry gates.
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy only into fully underwritten TIER_1/TIER_2 opportunities clearing >= 1.5:1 support-zone asymmetry.

destinations.rationale: MCX offers financial-market infrastructure exposure with 64.3% ROE and a confirmed Stage 2 BUY_AT_CMP_NO_FOMO posture at ₹3,535, though it requires its own dedicated full monograph before capital commitment.
destinations.entry_condition: Complete full MCX underwriting before allocating from cash.

destinations.rationale: KFINTECH competes directly in CRA/registry infrastructure with 21.6% ROE and 29.2% ROCE, offering superior capital efficiency to PROTEAN, though the facts ledger records it in Stage 3 (50D SMA ₹887.17 below 200D SMA ₹910.73) at ₹935.
destinations.entry_condition: Monitor for a confirmed Stage 2 trend reset and full underwriting before allocating capital.

primer: Protean eGov builds large Digital Public Infrastructure across PAN tax services, 97% CRA pension accounts, e-Sign, and UIDAI centres. We assign a REJECTED verdict for new capital at ₹705.60 (36.6x–38.3x P/E for 10.0% ROE). The stock trades above our ₹650 Base Case fair value ahead of a post-FY27 PAN 2.0 cliff and ₹12 Cr FY26 Free Cash Flow. Protean is not held in the Zerodha ledger (NOT_HELD), so 100% of marginal capital stays in cash. Only sustained operating margins above 15% with sub-65-day debtor cycles, or a drop below ₹550, would alter this view.
